from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and its citation relationships within the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title")
    cites_other_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites")
    cited_by_other_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
